_comment: Example safety/support configuration. crisis_resources is intentionally empty: the deploying team must add verified, region-appropriate contacts. Do not copy contact details from this file into production without verification.
urgent_support_message: It sounds like you may need help right now. This check-in cannot contact anyone or monitor your safety. If you are in immediate danger, please contact your local emergency services or someone near you now.
no_resources_message: No crisis contacts have been configured on this device.
support_handoff_message: I can't contact anyone myself, but your TactiDose app can help you choose how to reach someone.
